run_test_convtbc: run the unittest for ConvTBC to verify it matches nn.Conv1d output and gradients
test_ConvTBC_forward: test the ConvTBC forward pass produces equivalent output to nn.Conv1d with transposed tensors
test_ConvTBC_backward: test the ConvTBC backward pass produces equivalent gradients to nn.Conv1d for weight, bias, and input
review_TestConvTBC: review the TestConvTBC unittest class that validates ConvTBC equivalence with nn.Conv1d
summarize_test_convtbc: summarize the test_convtbc.py file that tests ConvTBC module against nn.Conv1d
